title: Frosted Orange Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: We love the location of the Coast is Clear. It is very close to the adult pool and the much-loved family pool, as well as the fitness center. We also loved the location because it is quiet - within walking distance of the beach and the town square but also set back enough that it's very peaceful. The kids loved every minute and the home itself is perfect for families. Clean, well-equipped, and very comfortable. The outdoor shower, rooftop deck, open kitchen, and tower bedroom are all great touches. We hope to be back! Ascend a spiral staircase to discover one of the home's best-kept secrets: a loft-style space surrounded by windows and cozy seating. This intriguing area doubles as a sleeping loft, complete with twin beds and a flat-screen television. Escape to yet another private balcony or climb a short ladder staircase to the rooftop deck, where you can bask in your secluded paradise. Marvel at the outstanding Gulf views as you relax high above the treetops, savoring the magic of the Seaside.
